data.narrative:
Precision AI is a Series A–stage drone and autonomous systems company founded by Daniel McCann that has raised $20M to date. The valuation universe comprises eight private companies in the Drones & Autonomous sector, including peers such as Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, Archer Aviation, and Elroy Air. No public comparables exist in this narrowly defined subsector.

Only one valuation method proved applicable given data constraints. Stage-Progression analysis uses Precision AI's $20M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to Series B or equivalent, yielding an implied valuation of $40M. Peer-Median analysis was not applicable: while five same-sector peers exist, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier identified fewer than three datapoints, making a narrow peer median unreliable. A broader sector median would lack precision given the heterogeneity in business models and maturity across the Drones & Autonomous universe.

The triangulated range is $34M (low) to $46M (high), with a median of $40M. This range reflects limited methodological support—a single applicable approach—and underscores the primary uncertainty: the absence of sufficient contemporaneous Series A comparables in this subsector. Material valuation movement would depend on evidence of revenue trajectory, customer concentration, and technical differentiation relative to the broader peer set.
